text: Jun said, “I want to give Willa the gift pear.” Tessa told Jun, “I would like to pick a pear.” Tessa borrowed the picking basket. The golden pear was unripe. Jun pulled the picking basket. The high branch was bending. Tessa said, “I need to stop.” He lowered the picking basket. Tessa picked the ripe pear from the low branch. The ripe pear was bruised. Using the picnic knife, Tessa trimmed the ripe pear. Tessa returned the picking basket to the shed. Tessa put the gift pear on the puppet table. The high branch was unbent. The golden pear shone on the high branch.
